text:
zoe: FYI customer BrightEdge (AP team) rejected our invoice PDF — they flagged that the 'Registered legal name' line is missing and the VAT breakdown doesn't line up with the PO placement. They blocked payment until we resend. Can someone triage? :warning:

eli: Which invoice id / template version? Any sample payload we sent?

zoe: invoice id `inv_7788`, template `eu_invoice_v2` (we think). Sample payload we submitted via Billing API:

```json
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_7788",
  "customer_id": "cust_brightedge",
  "po_number": "PO-9981",
  "line_items": [
    {"desc": "Redwood Inference API - monthly", "qty": 1, "unit_price": 5000}
  ],
  "billing_profile": {
    "short_name": "BrightEdge",
    "legal_name": ""
  },
  "tax": {
    "vat_number": "GB123456789",
    "vat_breakdown": [{"rate":20,"amount":100}]
  }
}
```

zoe: PDF they returned (screenshot) shows header with short name but no explicit "Registered legal name" line, and PO ended up in the footer so AP's PO-matching failed.

maya: Our template logic intentionally hides the "Registered legal name" block if `billing_profile.legal_name` is falsy. Problem: customers sometimes send an empty string instead of omitting the field. The template only checks existence, not emptiness. That would hide the line even though AP expects the label present.

chris: I can repro locally. `eu_invoice_v2` has this snippet:

```mustache
{{#billing_profile.legal_name}}
Registered legal name: {{billing_profile.legal_name}}
{{/billing_profile.legal_name}}
```

When `legal_name` === "" the section evaluates false. UX suggestion: always render the label and fallback to short_name if legal_name is empty.

samir: Looking into generator logs and repro steps. Found a rendering run at approx ts 1859994300 for `inv_7788`. Command I used to reproduce:

```bash
./scripts/generate_invoice --id inv_7788 --template eu_invoice_v2 --out /tmp/inv_7788.pdf
```

Output shows missing Registered name block. Quick cause: mustache treats empty string as falsy. Patch plan: (1) update template to use a helper that treats empty string as missing but prints fallback `billing_profile.short_name`, (2) move `po_number` into header block for EU invoices so AP matching sees it immediately. I'll open a PR and push to staging.

eli: Can we do a scoped hotfix that only affects `eu_invoice_v2` rendering so we can re-issue today? Customer needs it same day. Also we should regenerate the same invoice id after patch.

samir: Yes, we'll scope to `eu_invoice_v2` and `inv_7788`. I'll tag QE for a smoke test: ensure PDF contains these lines in header in order: `Registered legal name: BrightEdge` and `PO: PO-9981`, and VAT line items table matches amounts.

chris: UX note: show label even when identical to short_name, e.g., `Registered legal name: BrightEdge (aka BrightEdge)`. Makes AP parsing simpler.

maya: Also note some AP systems expect the VAT breakdown as a per-line tax column next to line items rather than a separate summary section. Our template currently only renders the VAT summary. That mismatch triggered one of the rejections in the past — might be worth adding an optional per-line tax column for customers with `tax.vat_breakdown` present.

zoe: Please prioritize. Customer blocked the invoice and is escalating to collections. If we can't reissue today, they want a written note to their AP explaining the fix.

samir: PR opened: `github.com/redwood/invoice-templates/pull/542` — patch includes helper `display_legal_name(billing_profile)` and moves `po_number` to header for `eu_invoice_v2`. Deploy plan: staging smoke now, prod deploy after approval (~2-3 hours). I'll post status updates.

billing-bot: requeued invoice `inv_7788` for regeneration after template update.

pdf-generator-bot: smoke test passed on staging for `inv_7788` — header contains `Registered legal name: BrightEdge` and `PO: PO-9981`. PDF link: https://staging-pdfs.redwood.internal/inv_7788.pdf :thumbsup:

zoe: Thanks all — please ping when prod is live so I can notify the customer and request release of funds. :pray:
